text:
Rina: heads up — deploybot suggested unpin of runtime-4.0 -> prod during the 02:00 UTC window. Theres a potential embeddings SDK shape mismatch for a small cohort.

deploybot: Proposed action: unpin runtime-4.0 -> prod; window=2026-04-02T02:00Z; canary=us-east-1; prechecks=kv-cache,embed-compat; reply :approve: or :hold:.

Ethan: Context: SDK embeddings v2.0 changed the batched input shape semantics. Hosted SDK roll is staged but not fully in prod; some customers using older client libs may see dim-mismatch errors when runtime switches.

Vik: How many customers/keys hit that path? Can we do a targeted exception keyed on request.header X-Client-Version < 2.0 instead of model tags?

Rina: We found 9 API keys with legacy clients across regions. Options: (1) delay unpin 12h, (2) add header-based exception to keep legacy clients on runtime-3.9 for 24h, (3) gate rollout to 10% with strict rollback. Recommend #2 + phased rollout.

deploybot: Suggested exception snippet for deploy-configs:
```
route_exceptions:
  - when: request.headers["X-Client-Version"] < "2.0"
    action: keep_runtime
    runtime: runtime-3.9
    ttl: 24h
rollout_phases:
  - pct: 10
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 40
    duration: 60m
rollback_policy:
  - metric: embed_error_rate
    threshold: 1.2x_baseline
    window: 5m
    action: rollback_to runtime-3.9
```

Ethan: That header comparison is easy to implement. Also add an alert for embed_error_rate and p99 latency. Support needs a KB blurb.

ops-bot: Alert configured: embed_error_rate > 1.2x baseline for 5m OR p99_latency > 2x baseline for 10m -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases; auto-rollback enabled. Metrics will stream to #eng-releases-metrics.

support-bot: Please include internal support note: "Customers with older SDK clients may be temporarily kept on runtime-3.9; upgrade to SDK embeddings v2.0 (ticket: SDK-3021) to be migrated." Support will prepare customer list and canned responses.

Vik: Two asks: 1) canary region should be us-east-1 only, avoid eu for first phase; 2) include a quick manual rollback command in the runbook.

deploybot: Added runbook pointer: infra/runbooks/runtime-rollback.md and constrained canary -> us-east-1. Suggested rollback command:
```
# rollback to pinned runtime
deployctl runtime set-global --version runtime-3.9 --reason "auto-rollback from embed_error_rate"
```

Rina: I'm fine with that plan. I'll draft the release note and post 30m prior. We'll monitor embed_error_rate, p99_latency, and kv-cache errors. If any alert fires, ops will decide immediate rollback.

Ethan: I'll open the PR to deploy-configs and run a staging smoke (including a synthetic embedding call with old-client header).

Ethan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/901 — staging applied, synthetic tests passed.

Vik: Marking :approve: given the exception rule, alerts, and runbook are in place. I'll be oncall during the window.

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-4.0 -> prod at 2026-04-02T02:00Z; rollout phases configured; prechecks passed.

Rina: I'll post the customer-facing blurb (include SDK-3021) and stick around for the window. If we see embed_error_rate spike >1.2x for 5m, auto-rollback should trigger; oncall will confirm.

support-bot: Support-ready. KB and customer list prepared.

Ethan: I'll watch synthetic checks and metrics channel. End of thread.
